input.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that we must be able to exit for convenience on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees. We have removed the delayed start tied to First Commercial Sale, fixed the notice period at thirty (30) days and added the pro-rata refund; Array retains no convenience exit under Article 13. If helpful, we can discuss 60-90 days' notice as a fallback.
input.summary: Make Ono's at-will termination right available immediately on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees.

ops.oldText: 13.2 Termination by Ono without Cause. Commencing on the later of (i) [ * ] of the First Commercial Sale of the Binimetinib Product in the Ono Territory, or (ii) [ * ] of the First Commercial Sale of the Encorafenib Product in the Ono Territory, Ono shall have the right to terminate this Agreement, for any reasons by giving [ * ] advance written notice to Array which shall be accompanied by the rationale for such termination.
ops.newText: 13.2 Termination by Ono without Cause. Ono shall have the right to terminate this Agreement at any time, for any reasons by giving thirty (30) days advance written notice to Array which shall be accompanied by the rationale for such termination. Array shall refund to Ono, on a pro rata basis, any fees prepaid by Ono for the period after the effective date of such termination.
